notes:
Chats no longer hang: photos load in the background and only what changed is redrawn, also while a video is sending.
One tap anywhere on a photo or video opens it.
Voice message waves show at once, the newest first.
A voice message keeps playing when you leave its chat; a bar in the chats pauses or stops it.
The video player shows while a video loads, and offers another app when it can't play one.
